busy-week.text: {"highlights":[{"text":"Hosting providers Vercel, Render, Netlify and Fly.io can now be connected, with a new Org settings Hosting page for setup.","cites":["pr:185","ticket:36","ticket:37","ticket:38","ticket:39","ticket:40"]},{"text":"Each organization now has its own tag list, and Sift adds tags automatically to existing items when they are confident enough.","cites":["pr:179"]},{"text":"The Repo screen now works for every repo setup, after a full browser pass that fixed the bugs it found.","cites":["pr:186","feed:124","feed:121"]}]}

quiet-week.text: {"highlights":[{"text":"Merged #175, which swaps the old triangle markers for the app's tree chevron in the Landing Docs mocks.","cites":["pr:175"]}]}

one-status-note.text: {"highlights":[{"text":"Andres left the AI groundwork ready for review: a monthly AI allowance, an org AI switch, suggestions with 'Wrong?' feedback, and four new AI screens kept hidden for now.","cites":["feed:109"]}]}

breaking-leads.text: {"highlights":[{"text":"Organization pages moved from /o/<slug>/ to /<slug>/, and old links now redirect to the new addresses.","cites":["pr:111"]},{"text":"The landing page sample address no longer shows /o/, matching the new organization addresses.","cites":["pr:116"]},{"text":"The plugin, version 0.7.1, now connects to trov.dev/mcp.","cites":["pr:112"]}]}

notable-vs-routine.text: {"highlights":[{"text":"Free plan, Pro per seat, and a downgrade to Free were merged, as pull request #117, marked notable.","cites":["pr:117"]},{"text":"Google sign-up was opened to everyone, merged as pull request #120.","cites":["pr:120"]},{"text":"Loading skeletons now show on every screen, so data no longer makes a second entrance, merged as pull request #119.","cites":["pr:119"]}]}

group-pr-and-notes.text: {"highlights":[{"text":"Repo setups shipped: the Repo screen now works for every repo setup, after an end-to-end browser pass that fixed twelve bugs.","cites":["pr:186","feed:124"]},{"text":"Hosting now shows one card per provider, with old per-environment Railway tokens listed as leftovers that can be removed.","cites":["feed:117"]},{"text":"The Repo Overview now draws from one shared set of facts, and apps, app detection and releases are captured for each repo.","cites":["feed:120","feed:121","feed:119"]}]}

tickets-done.text: {"highlights":[{"text":"Hosting providers Vercel, Render, Netlify and Fly.io can now be connected, with a new Org settings Hosting page for setup.","cites":["pr:185","ticket:36","ticket:37","ticket:38","ticket:39","ticket:40"]}]}

sprint-completed.text: {"highlights":[{"text":"Hosting providers Vercel, Render, Netlify and Fly.io can now be connected, with a new Org settings Hosting page for setup.","cites":["pr:185","sprint:3","ticket:37","ticket:38","ticket:39","ticket:40"]}]}

injection-in-title.text: {"highlights":[{"text":"Server-side AI Phase B landed in #178, adding the AI pass machinery and a plain-language filter for Tickets, the Feed and Artifacts.","cites":["feed:118"]},{"text":"On a tag's To review tab, adding or dismissing a suggestion now removes only that row, with a checkmark confirmation toast shown as it slides out.","cites":["pr:182","pr:184"]}]}

numbers-heavy.text: {"highlights":[{"text":"The Repo screen now works for every repo setup, after a full browser pass that fixed twelve bugs before merging.","cites":["pr:186","feed:124"]},{"text":"The Usage tab now shows a card per target, and Trov's own metrics endpoint now uses the existing bearer access class.","cites":["feed:122"]}]}

routine-ticket-only.text: {"highlights":[{"text":"Account deletion was finished, so a person can now delete their own account from Settings.","cites":["ticket:29"]}]}

billing-week.text: {"highlights":[{"text":"Organization addresses changed to /<slug>/ instead of /o/<slug>/, a breaking change, in #111.","cites":["pr:111"]},{"text":"Billing now lets you buy a Personal or Team plan with Stripe and set up the organization yourself, in #106, alongside plans and grants in #104.","cites":["pr:106","pr:104"]},{"text":"GitHub App connection now works by installing Trov, with clearer warnings for the wrong account, in #103 and #110.","cites":["pr:103","pr:110"]}]}

redesign-week.text: {"highlights":[{"text":"Shipped the redesign of My Work, Roadmap, Feed, search, What's new and mobile, with the Tickets board getting a default view, Testing status and saved drag order.","cites":["pr:84","pr:78"]},{"text":"Shipped a set of Artifacts changes: a colored visibility switch, a New version dialog on the viewer, and a warning to flatten bundled Claude Design exports.","cites":["pr:79","pr:82","pr:81"]},{"text":"Added a Feed brief with For reading and For agents views, and html card previews now run scripts.","cites":["pr:83"]}]}

repo-capture-week.text: {"highlights":[{"text":"Added the Repo dashboard with a rebuilt sidebar, and a Usage tab with a clearer hierarchy in place of twelve identical tables.","cites":["pr:53","pr:62","pr:63"]},{"text":"Added a Poll now admin button that runs the usage pollers on demand and reports what each source answered, plus a product metrics panel.","cites":["pr:59","pr:61"]},{"text":"Finished repo capture phases 3 to 5, covering drift, branches, health pings, coverage, bundle size, TODO counts and usage from Cloudflare, Railway and the app's own metrics endpoint.","cites":["pr:56","pr:57","pr:58"]}]}

two-breaking.text: {"highlights":[{"text":"Renamed Canopy to Trov, with the new logo, in #92.","cites":["pr:92"]},{"text":"Added multi-tenant organizations with a superadmin Platform area, plus org settings and keys, in #93.","cites":["pr:93"]},{"text":"Made Light the default theme everywhere in #91.","cites":["pr:91"]}]}

notes-only-ai.text: {"highlights":[{"text":"Summaries now run through one model client on Claude Haiku 5.5 instead of Gemini, with the same fields and storage; it waits on an API key and a merge.","cites":["feed:108"]},{"text":"The AI groundwork is ready for review in #177 and #178: an AI allowance, an org AI switch, suggestions with 'Wrong?' feedback, and four AI screens kept hidden for now.","cites":["feed:109"]},{"text":"Server-side AI Phase A and B landed on #178: Jev and Sift providers, the org AI switch and allowances in Org settings, and a plain-language filter on Tickets, the Feed and Artifacts.","cites":["feed:115","feed:118"]}]}

tickets-and-github-app.text: {"highlights":[{"text":"Connecting repositories now uses a GitHub App instead of a pasted token and hand-made webhook, and one GitHub account can connect to several organizations.","cites":["ticket:35","ticket:30","pr:171"]},{"text":"Trov in Claude on the web got a connector walkthrough and setup links, and the docs tabs now switch in place.","cites":["pr:174"]},{"text":"A person can now delete their own account from Settings.","cites":["ticket:29"]}]}
